Define the location of the resulting bundle. By default it is a folder called `build`, adjacent to the [Remotion Root](/docs/terminology/remotion-root).

## CLI flag

```text
--out-dir <value>
```

The following CLI commands accept this option:

- [`remotion bundle`](/docs/cli/bundle)

## APIs that have this option

The following APIs accept this option:

- [`bundle()`](/docs/bundle#outdir)

## Config file

```ts twoslash title="remotion.config.ts"
import {Config} from '@remotion/cli/config';
// ---cut---
Config.setBundleOutDir('./custom-build-dir');
```
